title: Learning Regions of Attraction for Transverse Feedback Linearization under Controller Singularities
abstract: arXiv:2611.22286v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Transverse feedback linearization (TFL) achieves path following by exactly linearizing the error dynamics, but its controller is undefined on a singular set, such as zero speed for a unicycle or zero thrust for a quadrotor. The constrained region of attraction, the set of initial states from which the closed loop converges to the path without violating state or regularity constraints, determines where the controller can be safely activated. Exploiting the exact linear error dynamics, we show that this region is the largest forward invariant subset of the admissible set. We then decompose its state-constrained Zubov value function into an analytically known quadratic cost-to-go and a safety value function. We learn only the latter, by fitted value iteration without infinite-horizon trajectory labels. The resulting estimate combines an inner layer verified by interval branch and bound with a learned outer layer tested on samples. On a unic

translated_title: 控制器奇异条件下横向反馈线性化的吸引域学习
translated_abstract: 横向反馈线性化（TFL）通过精确线性化误差动力学来实现路径跟随，但其控制器在某个奇异集上无定义，例如独轮车的零速度或四旋翼的零推力。受约束吸引域——即闭环系统在不违反状态或正则性约束的前提下收敛到路径的初始状态集合——决定了控制器可以被安全激活的区域。利用精确的线性误差动力学，我们证明该区域是可容许集的最大前向不变子集。随后，我们将该区域的状态约束Zubov值函数分解为解析已知的二次代价项和一个安全值函数，并通过拟合值迭代仅学习后者，无需无限时域的轨迹标签。最终得到的估计由经区间分支定界验证的内层与在样本上测试的学习外层组合而成。在独轮……
tldr: 提出通过将状态约束的Zubov值函数分解为解析已知的二次代价项与仅需拟合值迭代学习的安全值函数，在控制器奇异点附近学习横向反馈线性化的受约束吸引域，并给出内层经区间分支定界验证、外层经样本测试的组合估计。
en_tdlr: Learns the constrained region of attraction for transverse feedback linearization near controller singularities by decomposing the state-constrained Zubov value function into an analytic quadratic cost-to-go and a learned safety value function, yielding an estimate with an interval branch-and-bound-verified inner layer and a sample-tested outer layer.
